description: A slimline mixer that sums eight polyphonic inputs through a single attenuverter

params.text: Sets the level of the summed inputs, -1 to +1, inverting the sum below zero

inputs.text: One of the inputs into the sum, taken at unity gain, despite Rack's tooltip for it reading Attenuverter
One of the inputs into the sum, taken at unity gain
Added to the attenuverter, 5V for a change of one, and the total is clamped to -1 and +1

outputs.text: The summed inputs after the attenuverter, saturated near 10V, with the channel count of whichever input has the most channels
